title: Empty ≡ filtered-empty ≡ error conflated
cues: One blank state used for no rows, active filters, and load/submit failures
ban: Empty, filtered-empty, and error must be distinct instructional states.
remediation: Apply split-empty-triad; stamp data-filtered-empty when filters are active; keep error/alert copy distinct from empty; re-measure empty-triad.
